verdict.rationale: Name.com documents a Check Availability endpoint that checks up to 50 domain names at once and returns pricing. It is backed by HTTP Basic auth, official TypeScript/Go/PHP SDKs, a sandbox environment for testing, and an official MCP server that lets agents call Core API operations. Missing for 10: any documented rate limits for the check/search endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the availability API works as described.
